consumer: The engine's u_has_item/npc_has_item dialogue-condition lambda (condition.cpp::set_has_item), which asks the yes/no question 'does the character actor possess at least one knife_combat?' via actor->charges_of()/has_amount().
scope: only the character's own carried items (on-person inventory, including items nested inside non-gun/non-magazine containers), as has_amount traverses contained items
decisive_source: src/condition.cpp::conditional_t<T>::set_has_item -- its body returns actor->charges_of(item_id) > 0 || actor->has_amount(item_id, 1), the engine-computed possession predicate a condition/dialogue/mission check consumes.
divergence: A knife_combat nested inside a container in the avatar's inventory (e.g. inside a backpack): the engine predicate has_amount descends into container contents and returns true, while a display serializer that only emits top-level inv_const_slice stacks (arcopolis_export.cpp::write_carried_items) would report it absent -- a wrong 'not carrying' answer.
